ev.q: Of 1,669 patients identified, 545 (33%) underwent serologic testing for HIV antibody. All results were negative.
545 patients (33% of the total 1,669) submitted serum samples.
1-sided, 97.5% confidence interval = 0--6.7 per 1,000 patients, via Poisson distribution
All samples were reported negative for HIV antibody
A lookback investigation of patients operated on by the infected surgeon during the preceding 10 years was conducted
